data.title: Muslim World League Condemns Iranian Attacks on Bahrain
data.content:
Makkah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Muslim World League (MWL) strongly condemned the Iranian attacks targeting a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain.
    In a statement issued by the MWL General Secretariat on Sunday, MWL Secretary-General and Chairman of the Organization of Muslim Scholars Sheikh Dr. Mohammed Al-Issa reiterated his condemnation of the attacks. He described them as heinous violations of religious values and international and humanitarian laws and norms.
    He warned that the attacks pose a serious threat to regional security and stability and the safety of its peoples, while undermining peace efforts. Al-Issa affirmed the MWL's full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures it takes to safeguard its security, sovereignty, and the safety of its citizens and residents.
    -- SPA
